consequence.statement: CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool resources using spec.cidrs must be migrated to spec.blocks before upgrading to v1.16; the cidrs field will be removed.
consequence.remediation: Update all CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool resources to use spec.blocks instead of spec.cidrs before upgrading to Cilium v1.16.

proposed.statement: The CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool.spec.cidrs field is removed in v1.16; environments must migrate to spec.blocks before upgrading.
